CustomObject.label: Value Snapshot
CustomObject.description: One record per day: what the platform measured over the trailing window, next to the as-is baseline, and what it is worth in staff time and money. Written by ValueSnapshotService (nightly, ValueSnapshotJob); the Business Value dashboard reports on it. Assumptions come from Value_Assumption__mdt and are copied onto each record, so a later change of assumption does not rewrite history.
